top_signals.title: CFTC Aims to Publish Commitments of Traders Report Twice Weekly
top_signals.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is working toward publishing its widely followed Commitments of Traders report twice a week by the end of the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Coca-Cola Raises Guidance, North America Sales Disappoint
top_signals.summary: Coca-Cola raised its 2026 full-year outlook on strong international demand for soda, but notched lower-than-expected sales volume in North America. Kristina Peterson reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: GQG’s Jain Looks Past Lula Rout, Says Selling Brazil a ‘Mistake’
top_signals.summary: As investors flee Brazil following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s surprise re-election, Rajiv Jain is preparing to do what he has done before: buy into the panic.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
